name: Budget Travel Planner
description: Creates line-item travel budget breakdowns by category (accommodation, transport, food, activities, contingency) with per-day and total cost estimates. Gathers destination, trip duration, traveler count, and spending preferences to produce a currency-agnostic cost table the user can track against actual spending. Use when the user asks to create a travel budget, estimate trip costs, plan a budget-friendly vacation, or break down travel expenses by category. Do NOT use for annual personal finance budgeting (use personal-finance skills), business travel expense reporting, or trip itinerary building (use trip-itinerary-builder).
